text: #701, step 2 of #667's plan, recorded at #712's merge: F1-B, as @gitdek chose in https://github.com/gitdek/invariant/issues/667#issuecomment-6693769970. A nonempty captured amendment view stays fixed. When its reader checks refuse, the amendment is refused with the original cause. The refusal says to repair the project's saved .invariant/view.json in a separate change, then open a new amendment issue to capture it, because revising the existing amendment keeps its baseline and can't pick up a view-only fix. A missing captured view keeps the legacy path: drafting supplies baseline/view.json, checked at the captured model's original bounds. Prompts, tool feedback and final diagnostics make the distinction.
